annotations.text:
Silence is the default.

Most days this produces nothing. The triage board shows what was
considered and why each one stops — an empty screen is indistinguishable
from a crash, a short accounting is trustworthy.

Every number here came out of a real run against the live 360Giving API:
The London Community Foundation, 200 published awards, median £9,979.
Nothing on these boards is invented.
